title: Spookity's Oresome Ores
description: This mod adds several ORESOME ores and items to make the minecraft experience better! It also adds more endgame elements to add overall more things to do.
body:
![The logo for the mod, including most of the ores, and official title.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad297b98a0b58b0ede99411c2440dd864c62f8b9.png)
Welcome to Spookity's Oresome Ores! This mod not only adds several ores but many other items such as the Totem Of Infinity, Tomatoes, and more to come in future updates. It gives you more things to do and make, and even adds more things to The End so that you'll never run out of stuff to find. 

### -- INTRODUCTION --

In order to discover some of the blocks and items, you have to complete specific tasks. Many of the ores in this mod are particularly rare. Below, you will see a list of every ore and where they can be. Careful, this might spoil some of the mod.

Serpentine: Y 0 to Y 820

Ruby: Y -64 to Y 820

Carnelian: Y -64 to Y 820

Buried Geode (Overworld): Y 0 to Y 604

Charoite: Y -64 to Y 64

Amazonite: Y 0 to Y 155

Rhodium: Only found in Y -64!

Charoite (End): Y -64 to Y 820

Labradorite: Only found in Y -64!

Moonstone (End): Y 0 to Y 820

Buried Geode (Lavaland): Y -64 to Y 128

White Marble: Y -64 to Y 0

Black Marble: Y -64 to Y 0

### ---------------------------------------

!["Foods"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c8b18258210a74a93cc39924bb8845d4bd337fa_0.webp)

Wild tomato plants can be found in most forests, meadows, and plains. You can break them to get a tomato, which can be crafted into many different food items.

Similarly, wild peanut plants can be found in forests, meadows, and plains as well. Peanuts have a slightly wider range of biomes to spawn in. You can also break them to get a peanut, which you can craft into peanut butter with the Stone Masher (Six cobblestone needed to make the Stone Masher)

Grape trees can be found spawning in forest biomes, or the new Grape Orchards. You can break the leaves to get grapes, which can be mashed into jelly. If you combine bread, peanut butter, and jelly, you can make a PB&J Sandwich.

Cheese can be made by putting milk in a blast furnace. Cheese is needed for several other foods, such as simple ones like Pizza or more creative ones like Cheesy Baked Tomato.

Mashed potatoes can be made with two potatoes and a bowl, it replenishes 5/8 of the food bar and increases saturation by 0.4
